prompt: Generate a visual poster with Oriental aesthetics centered on specific thematic content. The core image uses a large area of clean negative space as the main stage. The subject is refined into a slender, restrained, handcrafted line drawing form, placed to one side within the white space, with rhythmic line density that feels like both a natural form and an information symbol. The white space is surrounded by a continuous undulating bas-relief texture field, like layers of material surfaces, softly enclosing from edges to center. A small number of tiny figures in laboring, walking, or operating poses are added as scale and narrative points, creating tension between macro textures and micro actions. Strong headlines and secondary information layers are set at the top. Colors are extracted from the theme itself, mapped to large high-brightness clean base colors and low-saturation structural textures. The texture has a paper embossing and fine line scoring feel.
